page.title: Reservations
page.subtitle: View reserved tables; manage guest arrival, edits, and cancellations.
page.noBranch: Select a branch or have a branch assigned to your account to list reservations.
page.emptyTablesTitle: No reserved tables at this branch right now.
page.emptyTablesHint: For new reservations, reserve an empty table from <link>Table management</link>.

cancelModal.title: Cancel reservation
cancelModal.description: Are you sure you want to clear the reservation for table <bold>{name}</bold> and mark it available?

editModal.title: Edit reservation
editModal.errorPartyInvalid: Party size must be a positive number.

ledger.title: Reservation ledger
ledger.description: Records are filtered by the branch selected at the top. Assigning a table on new entries updates the floor plan to "Reserved".
ledger.deleteDescription: The reservation for <bold>{customer}</bold> ({time}) will be permanently deleted. For pending or confirmed reservations with a table, the floor-plan reservation is removed as well.

alertSettings.title: Arrival alert settings
alertSettings.description: Configure when recurring arrival alerts are sent to waiter, POS, and mobile screens before each reservation time.
alertSettings.leadHint: 0 = only at reservation time; max 180 min.
alertSettings.intervalHint: Alerts repeat at this interval until the guest is seated or the reservation is closed.
